mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% for three consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces input demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the unemployment rate and a fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the same month signals accelerating labor market slack, which reduces consumer demand and corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases AND PAYEMS decreases by >100,000 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the federal funds rate below 2% during a recessionary regime signals an aggressive monetary easing, which lowers long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +2%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of at least 0.4% for three consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which raises corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change >= 0.4% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
